header.title: About Sahar Mahmoud
header.description: Frontend engineer based in Fayoum, Egypt, focused on building fast, well-crafted interfaces — and folding AI automation into the workflow behind them.
header.caption: Sahar Mahmoud — Frontend Engineer, AI Automation

story.title: How I got here
story.paragraph1: I graduated with a commerce degree, then taught myself frontend three years ago through online courses: JavaScript, HTML and CSS, then React, Next.js and Tailwind CSS. I later spent three months as a trainee at a software company, building a real survey product rather than a demo. There I learned Git and GitHub, clean architecture, clean code, and how to work with a real API.
story.paragraph2: AI is reshaping the market, so I've started studying AI automation and will begin a dedicated course next month. The goal is to fold it into how I build, while keeping every AI-generated output reviewed by a human before it ships.
